I am a treating physician at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

Treatment started on 2026-06-17.
Approximately 1 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild fatigue.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
D. Silva (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
